title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
summary: 超高層核心筒與巨柱的混凝土多以泵送輸送，600 m 的垂直高度本身就產生約 14 MPa 的靜壓，再加上高強度混凝土黏度高造成的管壁摩擦，泵機出口壓力可達 20 至 30 MPa 級。本課以哈里發塔 2008 年 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄、上海中心大廈約 580 m 的泵送、平安金融中心以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m 等案例，說明壓力組成、潤滑層流變、高壓管與接頭、泵機功率、管線固定、開泵與清管、可泵性試驗、溫度與坍流度監測、磨耗檢測與強度追溯。
summaryEn: Concrete for supertall cores and megacolumns is mostly pumped; a vertical lift of 600 m alone creates about 14 MPa of static head, and wall friction from viscous high-strength mixes pushes pump outlet pressures into the 20 to 30 MPa range. Using Burj Khalifa's 2008 vertical pumping record of 606 m, pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower and C100 concrete pumped to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center, the course covers pressure components, lubrication-layer rheology, high-pressure pipes and couplings, pump power, line fixing, start-up and flushing, pumpability testing, temperature and slump-flow monitoring, wear inspection and strength traceability.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高程泵送的壓力組成」與「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" and "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「泵送壓力需求」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump pressure demand” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。對超高層而言，靜壓與高度成正比，600 m 時已經非常可觀；摩擦則與管長、流速、管徑與混凝土流變有關，高強度混凝土的低水膠比與高膠結料量使它更黏，摩擦明顯高於一般混凝土。三者相加決定泵機等級、輸送管壁厚與接頭型式，也決定是否需要在中途設接力泵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「泵送壓力需求」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves. In supertall work static head grows linearly with height and is already very large at 600 m; friction depends on line length, velocity, pipe diameter and rheology, and the low water–binder ratio and high binder content of high-strength concrete make it stickier, with markedly higher friction than ordinary concrete. Their sum sets the pump class, pipe wall thickness and coupling type, and decides whether an intermediate relay pump is needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pump pressure demand” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「泵送壓力需求」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pump pressure demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

In supertall work static head grows linearly with height and is already very large at 600 m; friction depends on line length, velocity, pipe diameter and rheology, and the low water–binder ratio and high binder content of high-strength concrete make it stickier, with markedly higher friction than ordinary concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高程泵送的壓力組成」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" is correct?
options: 泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。
泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
optionsEn: Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
quiz.explanation: 泵機必須提供的壓力由三部分組成：把混凝土柱抬高的靜壓、混凝土沿管壁滑動的摩擦損失，以及彎管、錐形管與閥件的局部損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pressure a pump must deliver has three parts: static head to lift the concrete column, friction loss as concrete slides along the pipe wall, and local losses in bends, reducers and valves. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵送壓力需求」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump pressure demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。ρ = 2,450 kg/m³、h = 600 m 時靜壓 = 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度 i = 0.010 MPa/m、管長 L = 700 m 得 7.0 MPa；10 個彎管各 0.1 MPa 得 1.0 MPa；合計約 22.4 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. With ρ = 2,450 kg/m³ and h = 600 m the static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; a friction gradient i = 0.010 MPa/m over L = 700 m adds 7.0 MPa; ten bends at 0.1 MPa each add 1.0 MPa; the total is about 22.4 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。ρ = 2,450 kg/m³、h = 600 m 時靜壓 = 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度 i = 0.010 MPa/m、管長 L = 700 m 得 7.0 MPa；10 個彎管各 0.1 MPa 得 1.0 MPa；合計約 22.4 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. With ρ = 2,450 kg/m³ and h = 600 m the static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; a friction gradient i = 0.010 MPa/m over L = 700 m adds 7.0 MPa; ten bends at 0.1 MPa each add 1.0 MPa; the total is about 22.4 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高程泵送的壓力組成」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Components of high-rise pumping pressure", which statement holds?
options: 泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。
optionsEn: A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local.
quiz.explanation: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: p = ρgh + i·L + Σp_local. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泵送壓力需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump pressure demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：泵送計畫要在每一個關鍵高程（例如每 100 m）重新計算泵壓與裕度，並明訂超過某壓力即需改配比、換管或設接力泵的決策點，由泵送工程師與混凝土供應商共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate pressure and margin at each key level, for example every 100 m, and set decision points at which a mix change, new pipes or a relay pump is triggered above a given pressure, signed jointly by the pumping engineer and the concrete supplier.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。
knowledge.textEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 泵送計畫要在每一個關鍵高程（例如每 100 m）重新計算泵壓與裕度，並明訂超過某壓力即需改配比、換管或設接力泵的決策點，由泵送工程師與混凝土供應商共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate pressure and margin at each key level, for example every 100 m, and set decision points at which a mix change, new pipes or a relay pump is triggered above a given pressure, signed jointly by the pumping engineer and the concrete supplier.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高程泵送的壓力組成」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Components of high-rise pumping pressure"?
options: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
optionsEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
quiz.explanation: 以泵送計畫書列出最高澆置點的高度、總管長、彎管數與假設摩擦梯度，計算所需泵壓並保留裕度；施工中以泵機壓力紀錄與管線上的壓力感測器比對預測值，並隨樓層升高逐段更新。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List the highest placement level, total line length, number of bends and assumed friction gradient in the pumping plan, compute the required pressure with a margin, and during construction compare pump pressure logs and in-line pressure sensors with predictions, updating them as the building rises. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高程泵送的壓力組成：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Components of high-rise pumping pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵送壓力需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump pressure demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三者相加決定泵機等級、輸送管壁厚與接頭型式，也決定是否需要在中途設接力泵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Their sum sets the pump class, pipe wall thickness and coupling type, and decides whether an intermediate relay pump is needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高程泵送的壓力組成」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Components of high-rise pumping pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
quiz.explanation: 只以靜壓估算泵壓、低估高強度混凝土的摩擦，樓層升高後泵壓不足，混凝土在管中停滯並堵管；泵壓接近設備上限時，管線接頭與 S 閥磨耗加速，爆管風險升高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimating pump pressure from static head alone and underrating friction of high-strength concrete leaves the pump short of pressure as the tower rises, so concrete stalls and blocks the line; running near the equipment limit accelerates wear of couplings and the S-valve and raises the risk of a pipe burst. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「管壁潤滑層」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。ACI 304.2R 指出這層邊界潤滑層只有在泵送連續、配比穩定且供料不斷時才能維持。高強度混凝土的漿體黏度高，潤滑層的剪應力也較高，因此同樣流速下摩擦更大；配比中加入適量的細粉料、黏度調整劑或選擇合適的減水劑，可以在不降低強度的情況下改善可泵性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「管壁潤滑層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. ACI 304.2R notes that this boundary lubrication layer survives only while pumping is continuous, the mix is consistent and supply is uninterrupted. High-strength concrete has a viscous paste, so the shear stress in the layer is higher and friction at a given velocity is greater; suitable fines, viscosity-modifying admixtures or a well-chosen superplasticiser can improve pumpability without reducing strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「管壁潤滑層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pipe-wall lubrication layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變
knowledge.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete
knowledge.text: 混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。ACI 304.2R 指出這層邊界潤滑層只有在泵送連續、配比穩定且供料不斷時才能維持。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. ACI 304.2R notes that this boundary lubrication layer survives only while pumping is continuous, the mix is consistent and supply is uninterrupted.

knowledge.text: 誤解：坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete" is correct?
options: 坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
混凝土在管中並不是像水一樣整體流動，而是以塞流方式前進：中間的混凝土幾乎不剪切，只靠管壁附近一層薄薄的漿體或砂漿潤滑層滑動。
optionsEn: The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.

quiz.explanationEn: Concrete does not flow through a pipe like water; it advances as a plug: the core barely shears and slides on a thin layer of paste or mortar at the wall. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管壁潤滑層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。管半徑 R = 0.0625 m、v = 1.0 m/s：一般高強配比 τ₀ = 30 Pa、η_i = 300 Pa·s/m，τ = 330 Pa，i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m；黏度加倍 η_i = 600 時 τ = 630 Pa，i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m，700 m 管線的總泵壓由約 22.8 MPa 升到約 29.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. With R = 0.0625 m and v = 1.0 m/s, a typical high-strength mix with τ₀ = 30 Pa and η_i = 300 Pa·s/m gives τ = 330 Pa and i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m; doubling η_i to 600 gives τ = 630 Pa and i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m, raising total pressure on a 700 m line from about 22.8 MPa to about 29.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。管半徑 R = 0.0625 m、v = 1.0 m/s：一般高強配比 τ₀ = 30 Pa、η_i = 300 Pa·s/m，τ = 330 Pa，i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m；黏度加倍 η_i = 600 時 τ = 630 Pa，i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m，700 m 管線的總泵壓由約 22.8 MPa 升到約 29.5 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. With R = 0.0625 m and v = 1.0 m/s, a typical high-strength mix with τ₀ = 30 Pa and η_i = 300 Pa·s/m gives τ = 330 Pa and i ≈ 0.0106 MPa/m; doubling η_i to 600 gives τ = 630 Pa and i ≈ 0.0202 MPa/m, raising total pressure on a 700 m line from about 22.8 MPa to about 29.5 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete", which statement holds?
options: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。
垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
optionsEn: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R.
A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
quiz.explanation: 管壁剪應力 τ = τ₀ + η_i·v，摩擦梯度 i = 2τ/R。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall shear stress τ = τ₀ + η_i·v and friction gradient i = 2τ/R. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管壁潤滑層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pipe-wall lubrication layer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度；把結果回填泵壓計算，選出在強度、坍流度與摩擦之間平衡的配比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：配比審查除強度與坍流度外，應要求提出可泵性證據（摩擦梯度或試驗迴路結果）與配比調整範圍；高層段若改用更高強度，必須重新做可泵性評估再放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mix review should require pumpability evidence, such as friction gradient or loop results, and an allowed adjustment range in addition to strength and slump flow; any switch to higher strength in upper zones must be re-evaluated for pumpability before release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.question: 要驗證「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以管道流變儀或試驗迴路量測不同配比的界面屈服應力與黏度常數，或以兩支相距已知距離的壓力感測器量測實際摩擦梯度。

quiz.explanationEn: Measure interface yield stress and viscous constant for candidate mixes with a tribometer or test loop, or measure actual friction gradient with two pressure sensors a known distance apart; feed the results back into the pressure calculation and choose a mix that balances strength, slump flow and friction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潤滑層與高強度混凝土的流變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The lubrication layer and the rheology of high-strength concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
輸送管只是管子，任何鋼管只要接得上就能用於超高層泵送。
為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A pump line is just pipe, so any steel pipe that fits can be used for supertall pumping.
Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages.
quiz.explanation: 為了提高強度而一味降低用水量，混凝土黏度大增，潤滑層變薄，泵壓急升並出現間歇性堵管；配比中粗骨材級配不良時，漿體被擠出而骨材在彎管處形成架橋，造成難以清除的堵塞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting water to chase strength sharply raises viscosity, thins the lubrication layer and makes pump pressure spike with intermittent blockages; a poorly graded coarse aggregate lets paste be squeezed out so aggregate bridges at bends and forms blockages that are hard to clear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
